profile.summary: Galvez is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Fastify, a high-performance Node.js web framework. Their contributions focus on enhancing Fastify's plugin ecosystem, tooling integration (e.g., Vite and ESM loaders), and API design improvements. The developer demonstrates strong skills in backend JavaScript, modern module systems, and community-driven developer experience enhancements. Contributions are primarily non-code (plugins, documentation) but reflect deep technical understanding of Fastify's internals and Node.js tooling.
